info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Recruitment Management API
info.description: The Recruitment Management API facilitates the recruitment process within banking human resource management systems. It enables businesses to streamline candidate submissions, manage job postings, and enhance collaboration among hiring teams. This API serves HR professionals, recruiters, and hiring managers who are looking to efficiently integrate recruitment functionalities into their existing systems. With this API, organizations can automate workflows and improve the overall hiring experience.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new recruitment entry in the human resource management system. It facilitates the addition of candidates, job postings, and relevant recruitment details to streamline the hiring process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit recruitment operations within the human resource management system. It contains all the necessary details for processing a recruitment request, allowing for data entry on potential new hires and their associated information.

201.description: Resource created successfully for the recruitment process.
